name: Law of Large Numbers for Dependent Random Variables

insights: Birkhoff's Ergodic Theorem is the definitive extension of SLLN to dependent variables
Classical SLLN is a special case: T = left shift on product space, f = first coordinate projection
Without ergodicity, limit is conditional expectation E[f|I], not a constant
Cocycle relation S_{n+m}f = S_nf + S_mf∘T^n is the key algebraic identity
Hierarchy: i.i.d. ⊂ mixing ⊂ ergodic ⊂ stationary captures dependence levels
builtItems: Defined IsMixing and examples (irrational rotation, doubling map)
Gallery data: meta.json with full annotations
